The '''Design Advocate''' is the [[Players Committee]] advocate for card design: creating new virtual cards, deciding whether errata are needed, proofing new cards and running playtesting. Early sources call the seat Card Design.<ref name="oc2024">PC organization chart PDF (PDF creation date 6 May 2024), [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (Wayback copy of 10 October 2026: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf archived PDF])</ref> The current Design Advocate is [[Chris Kelly]].

To contact the Players Committee, see the [https://www.starwarsccg.org/contact/ Contact page] on starwarsccg.org.
